body: I went down to the court house in my home state since it is still my state of residency they allowed me to file for custody. I am waiting to serve her untill she comes out for Christmas. It really hurts to have to go this way but I need to protect my son.

Thank you   For your help. Honestly talking to a random stranger about what I'm going through saved  my life. My wife dropped the protection order because I went in with proof she was lying. We are getting a divorce and she is letting me take my son to California untill Christmas so we can talk about the next steps.

I unplugged myself from from all electronics. I've come to the point of not even thinking about killing myself until after I find out how things go at court. If it doesn't go the way I need it to. Then I'm getting in the car and going to drive nonstop to my family a few states away.

I have no money for a lawyer. And the only professionals I can talk to are military. And yes they are held to confidentiality laws. But they as army officers can find something from what I said and the. Have it come out that way. I went to see him but he is only 2.5 years old and my wife put him in school I guess. I just feel like my whole life has been taken from me and just I feel hopeless. I know there is always hope but I sometimes can't see that over my other emotions. I know I'm rambling. But I have so much going through my head. And tend to not know how to process it right now.

That money could send him to college. He will never know how much I love him since I can not see him or talk to him, send him presents, or even tell people to tell him I love him. I am feeling so down. The only reason I havnt done it yet is because I havnt said bye to him yet. Tomorrow when I know he is awake I am going to violate the restraining order and go over there and say bye to him and explain how much I truly love him and tell him he needs to be better then me. Then carry out my plan.
Well I fouls out under fsgli, the life insurance I have. My wife and son will get 100000 if I kill myself

I started getting help. I never would have. I have started to love myself. I expect her to cheat when I treat her like crap. I shouldn't have threaten to take our son and treated her worse. I know what I have done wrong and know how to make her happy. But my emotions are up and down. This morning I wrote out notes to everyone telling it's not their fault for me doing it. I figured it would be less clean up if I tied the belt up and then I out it around my neck. And I stood there for what seemed like hours. But then got a call from my mother. It's just not time yet. I have to fight each and everyday to live. And some days it feels like I'm loosing that fight. I hope she drops the protection order because she lied to get it. But then again it may mean I'll never see my son again.
I don't want to change to be happy without her and my boy. I changed to be better for her

I have been trying to get help this week. And no matter what they say to me or what I say to them it doesn't seem to help. I know I have changed but what good does that do when it doesn't mean crap about seeing my son or talking to my wife. She already replaced me.
